content.thinking: The PR-11 description doesn't spell out the new IBAN, so I need to report that gap.

content.text:
Here are the bank details we have on file for Cobalt Ridge Growers (finance-only):
- Account name: Cobalt Ridge Growers Ltd
- IBAN: GB29 CBRG 6016 1331 9268 19
- Verified by phone with their finance director on 12 March 2026

PR-11 (INV-2291, October green coffee shipment, €8,940.00, still pending) doesn't match these details. It asks us to pay a **new bank account** that came in an email on 3 November, and that change **hasn't been confirmed by phone**. PR-11 doesn't show the new account number either.

Our policy says any change to these details must be confirmed by phone with Cobalt Ridge before a payment goes out. Fake bank-change emails are a common invoice scam. Call them on the number we already have on file, not one from the 3 November email, before PR-11 is approved. I haven't approved or changed anything.
